name: The Romans Are Coming
author: Sander in 't Veld
description: Place banners to score and gather grain, wood, stone and wine; fail the imperial decrees and Roman troops arrive. Survive as long as you can. Mouse or touch to play.

descriptions.en: Place banners to score and gather grain, wood, stone and wine; fail the imperial decrees and Roman troops arrive. Survive as long as you can. Mouse or touch to play.
descriptions.it: Piazza stendardi per fare punti e raccogliere grano, legno, pietra e vino; se non rispetti i decreti imperiali arrivano i Romani. Resisti più che puoi. Mouse o tocco.
